system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Two network logon attempts for ben.carter failed at 13:45:20 and 13:46:34 UTC; both report source IP 192.0.2.45 and substatus 0xc000006a.
At 13:48:08 UTC, a network logon for ben.carter succeeded from the same reported IP, 192.0.2.45. The event reports Kerberos authentication and WorkstationName=DC-HD-01.

The failed attempts followed by a successful network logon from an IP not attributed to a host in the supplied inventory merit investigation, but the records do not identify who or what controlled that source.

Ben.carter later had a successful type 2 logon on WS-BCARTER-01, followed by userinit.exe and explorer.exe startup. This is a separate local-interactive logon and does not establish the origin or legitimacy of the earlier network logon.

After the local session began, PowerShell ran an Invoke-RestMethod request to an internal API; Firefox opened graph.microsoft.com, and the proxy recorded a successful tunnel to that Microsoft endpoint. These events do not resolve the earlier authentication source.
